notes.title: Destiny of Ancient Kingdoms---OS Update Compensation
notes.content:
Dear valued player,

We apologize for all the disconnect during 15th/Dec/2016 due to the Microsoft Windows Server Automatically Update Program.

There was a hug update comes from Microsoft for windows server OS, most of player was having disconnection and slow connection problems. However, once we finished OS update, there was a compability issues with our game porter. That's why most of players can not login to the game.

Regards to the compensation, we will give all player extra 2000 Bound Prepaid Points for this OS update problem.

Compensation will be released together with previous compensation.
All player who send the compensation application will be received 5000 Bound Prepaid Points for hacker attack plus extra 2000 Bound Prepaid Point for OS update compensation from your in-game mail box.

Thanks for uderstanding and supporting.

Best Regards
DOAK Team

notes.title: Maintenance&Update - Wednesday (7th/Sep/2016) - Complete
notes.content:
Dear Valued Players

We regret to inform you that we will be shutting down the game server for 2 hours on the 7th of September 2016 so that our trained technicians can thoroughly conduct a game update. Please ensure that your characters are logged out of the game 20 minutes before the time of the game update. The times for the game update are listed according to your region below
 
New York                    02:00 (EDT/GMT -4)
South African              08:00 (CAT/GMT +2)
American central        01:00 (CST/GMT -6)
Los Angeles               23:00 (PDT/GMT -7) PREVIOUS DAY
London                       07:00 (BST/GMT +1)
Paris                          08:00 (CEST/GMT +2)
Rio de Janeiro           03:00 (AMST/GMT -3)
China/Singapore       14:00 (SGT/CST +8)
Japan                        15:00 (JST/GMT +9)
Turkey                       09:00 (EEST/GMT +3)
 
Changes that will be made in the upcoming update
 
 *) Gold Hole inlay bug fixed.
 *) Guild Level upgrade bug fixed.
 
We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the update. UDEA would like to thank you for your support, patience and understanding.
 
Best Regards
DOAK Team
